app.name: DYON
app.mission: Turn every commitment — money, service, promise or trust — from a hidden weight into a written, honoured, and released commitment.
app.title: DYON — The Commitments Ledger

dash.nothing_due: Nothing is due right now. That is a good place to be.

people.health_hint: You rate this. DYON never infers it.
flow.respite_sent: Respite requested. No pressure either way.
flow.release_done: Released. You can undo within 24 hours.
flow.transfer_consent: All three parties must consent. This records their consent; it does not obtain it.
flow.writeoff_note: Writing off is not forgiving. The debt stays recorded as owed but you stop expecting it.
flow.capacity_warn: Heads up: people usually underestimate. Is this date still realistic if something goes wrong?
flow.hardship_hint: Only you can declare this. DYON never infers it, and reminders become respite-oriented.
remind.preview: Message preview — you send it, not DYON
remind.cap: Caps: 1 per commitment per 7 days, 3 per person per month. Quiet hours {from}–{to}.
remind.capped: A reminder was sent recently. The cap protects the relationship.
remind.lint: This wording may feel like pressure or shame. Consider softening it.
remind.copied: Message copied. Send it from your own app.
remind.self_default: Self-reminders are on by default and stay private. They are the preferred path.
inbox.title: Inbox
plan.capacity_hint: What can you really set aside each month, after essentials? No interest is ever added.
plan.months_to_clear: ≈ {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} to clear at this pace
plan.no_plan: No plan yet. A plan is just a kinder order of steps.
calm.resources: If this is heavy, talk to someone
calm.resources_note: DYON is not therapy. Helplines differ by country; please check a local, current list.
checkin.thanks: Noted, privately. Thank you for telling the truth.
celebrate.released_received: {name} has released you from this debt.
celebrate.debt_free: You have no open "I owe" left in {unit}.
celebrate.badge: Share as an abstract badge (no names, no amounts)
onboarding.welcome: You're not alone. Let's write it down, step by step, without judgment.
onboarding.rough: Rough is fine — "Ali, maybe ~300?" We will mark it approximate.
onboarding.cat.items: Borrowed items: books, tools, cars, clothes
onboarding.summary: You've written down {items} with {people}. That took courage. Here's one small next step.
onboarding.privacy_promise: Everything stays on this device, in your browser. No account, no servers, no sharing.
set.converted_hint: Display only. It never revalues a debt (§6.3).
set.spiritual_hint: Device-only. Never synced, exported or shared (R-V03).
set.islamic_hint: A cultural layer only. It never changes amounts, rules or obligations, and is never transmitted.
set.lock_hint: A local convenience lock only. Anyone with this device and dev tools can read the data — never treat it as real security.
set.discreet_hint: Neutral app name and no amounts in previews (R-D31).
set.delete_confirm: This erases every record on this device. It cannot be undone. Type DELETE to confirm.
set.offline_ready: Offline-ready. Your data never leaves this device.
estate.title: Estate readiness (waṣiyyah)
estate.intro: Debts are settled before inheritance is distributed (4:11–12). This sheet is for your executor and heirs.
report.title: Reports
vault.title: Evidence vault
vault.intro: Receipts, transfers, notes. Stored only in this browser, with a SHA-256 fingerprint for each file.
islamic.title: Islamic corner
islamic.intention_text: I intend, by God's help, to repay what I owe and to deal with excellence.
islamic.spiritual_hint: Device-private. Never shared, exported or counted in any total.
islamic.cycle: The full cycle of the ethic of debt
legal.disclaimer: This record helps you remember and agree. Its legal weight depends on your country's law. It is not a contract drafted by a lawyer.
fiqh.disclaimer: Educational content, not a fatwa. Please consult a qualified scholar.
fx.display_only: Converted for display only, at {rate} on {date}. The debt stays in {unit}.
limit.no_riba: No interest, no late fees, no penalty — by design (RL-01).
limit.not_collector: DYON never contacts anyone for you. You send every message yourself.
misc.about_text: DYON is a personal ledger of commitments. It is not a lender, a collector, a credit bureau, an interest engine, a shaming platform, a fatwa authority, or a substitute for therapy or legal counsel.
app.use_browser_menu_add: Use your browser menu: "Add to Home Screen".
app.adds_demo_ledger_alongside: This adds a demo ledger alongside your current data. Continue?
auth.signed_out_ledger_stays: Signed out. Your ledger stays on this device.
auth.private_ledger_keeps_working: Your private ledger keeps working without an account. Signing in only unlocks the features that reach other people.
auth.no_provider_configured_on: No provider is configured on this copy yet, so sign-in runs in preview: a local test identity, clearly labelled, never treated as verified.
auth.dyon_reads_name_email: DYON reads your name and email, nothing else. No contacts, no posting.
auth.records_are_not_uploaded: Your records are not uploaded. They stay in this browser.
auth.export_delete_never_need: Export and delete never need an account (RL-09).
auth.sign_in_could_not: Sign-in could not be confirmed. Please try again.
auth.not_linked_everything_write: Not linked. Everything you write stays on this device. Link a social account only when you want to share with, remind or invite someone.
auth.unlocked_sharing_reminders_witnesse: Unlocked: sharing, reminders, witnesses, settlements, transfers. Your ledger is still stored only in this browser.
flows.known_person_their_saved: Known person — their saved kind is used.
flows.new_person_they_will: New person — they will be added to People.
flows.display_reference_only_never: A display reference only; it never changes the obligation.
flows.will_write_message_other: You will write a message to the other person after saving.
flows.sharing_needs_linked_social: Sharing needs a linked social account after saving. The record itself is saved on this device now.
flows.pick_due_date_or: Pick the due date, or choose "No date".
flows.add_at_least_one: Add at least one witness name, or pick another privacy option.
flows.year_was_assumed_please: The year was assumed — please check the date.
flows.recurring_promise_please_set: Recurring promise: please set a start date.
flows.link_shows_only_one: A link shows only this one commitment, never your other debts (R-D11). DYON messages nobody on your behalf (R-D10).
flows.mb_per_file_images: {mb} MB per file: images, PDF or audio.
flows.record_removed_from_device: This record is removed from your device; the audit trail keeps its trace.
flows.shared_record_tombstone_created: Shared record: a tombstone is created and the counterparty copy is untouched (R-M02).
flows.witness_read_only_can: A witness is read-only and can never edit.
flows.every_edit_written_into: Every edit is written into the append-only history with a diff. No silent edits (Sidq).
flows.i_closed_commitment_today: 🕊️ I closed a commitment today with DYON — no names, no amounts.
flows.please_confirm_understand_becomes: Please confirm you understand this becomes final after 24 hours.
flows.are_about_release_from: You are about to release {name} from this debt.
flows.i_understand_becomes_final: I understand this becomes final after 24 hours.
flows.one_record_two_views: One record, two views. The recorded amount is {amount} dated {date}. One party sees it differently. The aim is understanding, not winning.
flows.dispute_recorded_never_escalated: A dispute is recorded, never escalated. Tone switches to Neutral automatically.
flows.unit_change_happens_only: A unit change happens only via an explicit settlement, with the agreed rate recorded (§6.3).
flows.record_agreed_rate_when: Record the agreed rate when the unit changes.
flows.hardship_declared_so_template: Hardship is declared, so the template switched to a respite framing (R-D26).
flows.that_name_already_exists: That name already exists. Use a distinct name, or open the existing person.
flows.non_users_are_stored: Non-users are stored as minimal records (RL-08).
flows.personal_details_are_erased: Personal details are erased; your record remains with an alias (R-D12).

qr.details_travel_inside_code: The details travel inside the code itself; nothing is uploaded. DYON never sends it for you (R-D10).
qr.code_could_not_be: This code could not be read
qr.may_be_incomplete_or: It may be incomplete or from another app. Ask the sender to show it again.
qr.scanned_from_dyon_request: Scanned from a DYON request code.
qr.nothing_was_saved_yet: Nothing was saved yet. Adding it opens the normal form so you can check every field first. Replying is always done by you.

validate.transfer_needs_all_three: A transfer needs all three parties’ consent.

views.records_are_complete_well: Your records are complete. Well done.
views.every_closure_will_appear: Every closure will appear here. It deserves to be seen.
views.no_tips_today_everything: No tips today. Everything is clear.
views.counterparties_are_people_never: Counterparties are people, never "accounts receivable". The numbers serve the relationship.
views2.promise_commitment_scholars_diffe: A promise is a commitment. Scholars differ on whether it binds legally; many hold it binding morally. Here it becomes visible instead of lapsing silently.
views2.give_worker_his_wage: "Give the worker his wage before his sweat dries." Time and labour are real commitments, recorded in their own unit.
views2.god_commands_render_trusts: "God commands you to render trusts to their owners" (4:58). A trust is returned, in its condition and on time.
views2.suggested_order_only_no: A suggested order only. No increase, no interest, no pressure.
views2.due_dates_are_local: Due dates are local dates; they never shift across time zones (§6.5).
views2.reminders_go_only_debtor: Reminders go only to the debtor — never to family, employer or anyone else (R-D22).
views2.all_private_device_session: All private to this device. Session length and notification open-rate are deliberately NOT measured.
views2.every_change_written_append: Every change is written to an append-only log; each event carries the hash of the one before it.
views2.e_g_6_days: e.g. 6 days of Ramadan to make up
views2.use_whole_number_between: Use a whole number between 1 and 9999.
views2.hypocrisy_delay_texts_are: Hypocrisy and delay texts are never shown in a message to another person — only here, when you choose them.
views2.declared_limit_madhhabs_differ: Declared limit: madhhabs differ on whether a promise binds, on currency and gold questions, and on spiritual-debt calculations. DYON presents differences; it does not adjudicate them.
views2.calm_mode_lowers_arousal: Calm Mode lowers arousal before asking anything of you: totals are hidden and one kind step remains.
views2.choose_different_start_end: Choose a different start and end time.
views2.name: Your name
views2.that_file_not_valid: That file is not valid JSON.
views2.that_not_dyon_backup: That is not a DYON backup file.
views2.debt_stays_in_unit: A debt stays in the unit it was created in. The FX table is indicative and display-only ({source}, {as_of}).
views2.no_marketing_ever_no: No marketing, ever. No notifications to any third party, ever.
views2.pin_local_convenience_not: ⚠️ The PIN is a local convenience, not real security: the data lives in this browser and anyone with the device can read it. A static app cannot truly protect a private area.
views2.exports_exclude_spiritual_ledger: Exports exclude the spiritual ledger unless opted in per record (R-V03). Binary attachments stay on the device.
views2.install_dyon_as_app: Install DYON as an app on your device so it works offline.
views2.tip_export_backup_first: Tip: export a backup first if you are unsure.
views2.no_riba_or_interest: No riba or interest computation, ever.
views2.no_selling_or_sharing: No selling or sharing of user data.
views2.no_public_shaming_no: No public shaming, no defaulter lists.
views2.no_credit_score_shared: No credit score shared with third parties.
views2.no_dark_patterns_or: No dark patterns or manufactured urgency.
views2.no_algorithmic_decisions_against: No algorithmic decisions against users; hardship is self-declared.
views2.minimal_data_for_non: Minimal data for non-users, deleted on request.
views2.right_export_delete_everything: Right to export and delete everything.
views2.irreversibility_guard_24h_undo: Irreversibility guard: 24h undo on release, deletion and ḥawālah.
views2.no_ethics_laundering_red: No ethics laundering: red lines enforced in code.
views2.no_linguistic_flattening_arabic: No linguistic flattening: Arabic is authoritative for fiqh terms.
views2.not_replacement_for_therapy: Not a replacement for therapy or legal counsel
views2.not_legal_advice_enforceability: Not legal advice; enforceability depends on your jurisdiction.
views2.not_fatwa_islamic_content: Not a fatwa; Islamic content is educational and sourced.
views2.not_therapy_severe_distress: Not therapy; severe distress needs a professional.
views2.evidence_mostly_correlational_int: Evidence is mostly correlational; interventions are hypotheses to be measured.
views2.dyon_cannot_make_anyone: DYON cannot make anyone pay, nor verify an off-app payment.
views2.if_after_six_months: If, after six months, neither fulfilment nor self-reported debt anxiety improves, the core thesis is wrong and DYON must be redesigned rather than marketed. If fulfilment rises while anxiety or relationships worsen, that is a failure, not a success.
views2.add_rough_amount_or: Add a rough amount or a short description.
views2.guide_explains_every_screen: The guide explains every screen and every word in plain language. Open it now and come back here any time.
views2.quick_tour_overview: A quick tour of the Overview
views2.only_needed_share_or: Only needed to share or remind someone

wellbeing.note: DYON is not therapy or legal advice. Helplines vary by country and change over time — please verify a current local list.
share.message:
Hello {name},
I've recorded: {amount} ({type}) dated {date}{hasDue, select, yes {, due {due}} other {}}.
Does this match what you have? I just want our notes to agree.

— Written with DYON. {disclaimer}
tpl.remind.gentle: Hi {name}, just a friendly note about the {amount} from {date}. No pressure at all. Let me know what works for you 🌿
tpl.remind.neutral: Reminder: {amount}, dated {date}. You can confirm a date that suits you.
tpl.remind.formal: This is a reminder regarding the outstanding amount of {amount} agreed on {date}.
tpl.remind.islamic: Assalamu alaikum {name}. A gentle reminder about the {amount}. And if you are in hardship, ask for respite and I will give it, in shaa Allah.
tpl.hardship: Hi {name}, no worry at all about the {amount}. Whenever things ease, tell me a timing that suits you. Take the time you need.
tpl.ask_for_me: Hi {name}, I'm tidying my records in DYON and it shows {amount}. Does that match what you have? No rush at all — I just want our notes to agree.
tpl.thanks: Thank you so much, {name}. Received and settled — and thank you for your patience.
tpl.release: {name}, I've released you from the {amount}. Nothing is owed — please don't carry it any more.
tpl.respite_request: Hello {name}, I'm in a tight spot right now regarding the {amount}. Could I ask for respite until {date}? I fully intend to fulfil it.
insight.no_due: {count, plural, one {# item has no due date.} other {# items have no due date.}} Adding one can lower uncertainty.
insight.approximate: {count, plural, one {# record is approximate.} other {# records are approximate.}} A quick check with the other person makes them solid.
insight.unshared: {count, plural, one {# record is private only.} other {# records are private only.}} Sharing one invites agreement before memory fades (2:282).
insight.no_evidence: {count, plural, one {# larger record has no attachment.} other {# larger records have no attachment.}} A photo of a receipt prevents future disputes.
insight.stale: {count, plural, one {# record hasn't moved in six months.} other {# records haven't moved in six months.}} A gentle check-in may be kind.
insight.no_plan: A plan is just a kinder order of steps. Building one takes a minute.
insight.no_executor: Naming an executor means your records help your family rather than confuse them.
